revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 4.3% after a 2024 dip (-3.4%); near-term backlog/pricing support moderates to GDP-plus growth by FY2029-30.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin 16.5% (11151/67589), FY2023-24 about 19-20%; 16% assumed given tariff/cost pressure and mid-cycle view.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approximate US statutory 21% plus state and foreign mix; not derived from filing in this draft.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 capex/revenue 4.2% (2821/67589); FY2023-24 lower at 2.4-3.1%; 4.0% reflects elevated investment fading toward D&A.

wacc.source: Assumption: CAPM with 10Y UST 4.86% (Treasury, 2026-11-06) + beta ~1.1 (assumed, not looked up) x US ERP 4.46% (Damodaran, 2026-02-16) = ~9.8% cost of equity; after-tax debt cost ~4.5% with sizeable debt weight (net debt 26.2B) gives ~9.0%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal growth below the 4.86% risk-free rate and near inflation plus modest real growth.

net_debt.source: CAT 10-K FY2025, accession 0000018230-26-000008: LongTermDebtNoncurrent 30,696 + ShortTermBorrowings 5,514 - cash 9,980 (deskstack derived net_debt)
